content.short: Bedrock is a multi-asset liquid restaking protocol that unlocks yield for Bitcoin, Ethereum, and other major assets.
content.description: Bedrock is a multi-asset liquid restaking protocol designed to enhance yield and liquidity for assets like Bitcoin, Ethereum, and IoTeX. By staking through Bedrock, users receive "liquid" tokens like uniBTC or uniETH, which represent their positions while remaining fully tradable across DeFi. This model allows participants to earn rewards without locking up capital, enabling them to use liquid tokens as collateral or for trading. The protocol focuses on maximizing capital efficiency and providing a seamless restaking experience. By integrating with various Proof-of-Stake networks, Bedrock secures decentralized networks while offering competitive returns and bridging secure staking and DeFi.
